title: CozCraft
description: Rei's edit of Cozy's original modpack for the CozCraft server. Contains only client-sided mods and any mods required by the server.
body:
Rei's edit of Cozy's original modpack for the CozCraft server. Contains only client-sided mods and any mods required by the server.

Contains mods for improving quality-of-life, performance, and adding additional mechanics. Also contains a couple of shaders and resource packs, but these are not required.
# Performance
These, basically, improve the overall performance of the game.

    BadOptimizations
    Entity Culling
    FerriteCore
    Lithium
    ModernFix
    Noisium
    Sodium
    Krypton
# Quality of Life
This helps take care of a few nuances with the game.

    AppleSkin - Shows your current saturation and exhaustion.
    Bow Infinity Fix - Allows you to fire infinity enchanted bows without needing an arrow.
    Enchantment Descriptions - Shows you what each enchantment do.
    No Chat Reports - Prevents players from reporting your messages, as long as the server allows unsigned messages.
    Mouse Tweaks - Improves mouse features, such as drag-clicking in inventories.
    Real Arrow Tip - Shows the correct arrow you're using when drawing your bow.
    Lootr - All loot chests in the world gives players their own loot table.
    StacKit - Increases stack sizes of items.
    Tax Free Levels - Decreases the amount of XP needed per level to level up.
# Vanilla+

    Craftsman's Bows
    Enchantments Plus
    Explorer's Compass
    Gravestones
    Farmer's Delight Refabricated
    The Aether
    Mythic Upgrades
    Waystones
    Basic Weapons
# Additional Mechanics

    Simple Voice Chat
# Resource Packs

    Sparkles: Stardust Labs Resourcepack
# Shaders

    Complementary Shaders - Reimagined
    FullBright2
There are also required dependency mods, such as libraries, included with this pack.
